scripts.features:
BYTESCODE
bytescode is a script for ttk system it uses obsidian ui for the ui part. it has a lot of exploits like infinite ammo, silent aim ecc. In few words it has mostly all the thing you would think for a game like ttk system. right now it has a key system (i need to do it for jnkie or i can obfuscate) please e careful when you try to get the key as everything you click on the jnkie part it might redirect to the wrong site basically everytimes you click it points you to a site but when you will find a site whit like get link box whit a article ecc. then that should be the right one, do not put any personal info, or do anything on your pc as the ad system i choosed does not require any action on your pc all you need to do is read the article and on that website you can also use adblock if i remember. I have also a discord server i just built so for support ecc. join the community and infact after putting the jnkie key system (so the one where you need to go to the browser ecc.) you will have another one but it's kinda optional, you need to join the discord server go to the key channel and paste the key, this is so more people join the discord server so they can be know if it ever gets detected, there is a problem or the user needs support. However i understand some people might not have discord or not want to join the discord server so you can wait 1 minute and you can skip that but it's not permament you will have again and again 1 minute of wait if you do so, i recommend putting the key as it's 1 time and you never put it again. if you need the key but whitout discord atp send me an email from my email: bytes_code@outlook.com or check comments maybe someone putted it. 

here are every features of the script:

ESP
Box (with outline + fill), name, health bar, HP number, distance, weapon esp, chams, skeleton, head circle, tracers, off-screen arrows with adjustable radius. Filters: team check, wall check, draw dead players, team colors, visible/hidden color esp, rainbow, box padding, max distance.

Aimbot
keybind whit toggle, always and hold (default hold), target part, FOV with on-screen circle, smoothing, prediction, team check, wall check. Moves your actual mouse when supported, otherwise the camera.

Silent aim
Same FOV/part/team/wall/prediction options as aimbot, hit chance, random part, response (a option like smoothness on aimbot but for silent aim), and no-spread.

Magic bullet
every shot gets trough the player, even behind walls. it's highly bannable so i wouldn't recommend abusing it

Exploit
No recoil, no spread, body penetration, no damage falloff, full auto, rapid fire, instant reload, infinite ammo, endless magazines, plus a re-apply button for after picking up a gun. Rapid fire / instant reload / infinite ammo are marked bannable.

Experimental Exploits
Remove telemetry (removes telemetry which might ban you or make you impossible to report so that's why i putted it as experimental anyways by default it's off so who cares)

Movement
Speedhack, aim speed, crouch speed, fly, noclip.

World
Lighting: fullbright, shadows, brightness, time, exposure, fog, ambient/fog colors. Effects: sun rays, bloom, color correction, atmosphere. Sky: 12 skybox presets . Camera: custom FOV, vertical stretch (like cs2), remove vignette.

Menu
Keybind list, custom cursor, always-on-top, notification side, UI scale, corner radius,  disable all , unload . Config saving/loading and obsidian theme presets included (the normal one is custom).

local function dragify(Main)
	local dragToggle, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
	Main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = Main.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragToggle = false end
			end)
		end
	end)
	Main.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragToggle then
			local Delta = input.Position - dragStart
			local Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + Delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + Delta.Y)
			TweenService:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Position = Position}):Play()
		end
	end)
end
